info.title: Update Promotion Activity Products
info.description: Use this API to add the products or SKUs to the list of a product discount activity or a flash deal activity. You can also change the discounts on existing products or SKUs. To remove the products or SKUs from the list, use [Remove Activity Product](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/650acfd84a0bb702c072b4eb).

put.description: Use this API to add the products or SKUs to the list of a product discount activity or a flash deal activity. You can also change the discounts on existing products or SKUs. To remove the products or SKUs from the list, use [Remove Activity Product](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/650acfd84a0bb702c072b4eb).

parameters.name: shop_cipher
parameters.description: Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response.

parameters.name: app_key
parameters.description: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Request body. Full source table is retained in x-tiktok-request-body-parameters.

products.description: The items to add to the list or the existing items in the list of promotion activity to edit. The length must not exceed `300`.

activity_id.description: A unique ID that identifies activities.

exclude_product_ids.description: IDs of the BXGY exclude products to remove.

200.description: Successful response. See source Markdown for complete semantics.

x-tiktok-request-body-parameters.Properties description: The items to add to the list or the existing items in the list of promotion activity to edit. The length must not exceed `300`.

x-tiktok-request-body-parameters.Properties: You must specify the value when `product_level==PRODUCT` and `activity_type==FIXED_PRICE / FLASHSALE`. The currency is the same between activity price and product price.

x-tiktok-request-body-parameters.Properties description: Discount value. If the product is 10% off, the value is `10`.

x-tiktok-request-body-parameters.Properties: You must specify the value when `product_level==PRODUCT` and `activity_type==DIRECT_DISCOUNT`; and you must not specify it when it's not.

x-tiktok-request-body-parameters.Properties description: The quantity limit of the products involved in the activity. The range is `[1, 99]`, or you can use `-1` for unlimited. If you are updating the value of an existing product, the value cannot be less than the current value.
Limit of product purchase per buyer. The range is `[1, 99]`, or you can use `-1` for unlimited. If you are updating the value of an existing product, the value cannot be less than the current value.
The SKUs to add to the list or to edit. The number of the SKUs across all products must not exceed 300 in an API call.

x-tiktok-request-body-parameters.Properties: You must specify the value to `[]` when `product_level==PRODUCT`.
You must specify the value when `product_level==VARIATION` and `activity_type==FIXED_PRICE / FLASHSALE`. The currency of activity price is the same as that of SKU price.

x-tiktok-request-body-parameters.Properties description: Discount value. If the SKU is 10% off, the value is `10`.

x-tiktok-request-body-parameters.Properties: You must specify the value when `product_level==VARIATION` and `activity_type==DIRECT_DISCOUNT`.

x-tiktok-request-body-parameters.Properties description: The quantity limit of the SKU involved in the activity. The range is `[1, 99]`, or you can use `-1` for unlimited. If you are updating the value of an existing SKU, the value cannot be decreased.
Limit of SKU purchase per buyer. The range is `[1, 99]`, or you can use `-1` for unlimited. If you are updating the value of an existing SKU, the value cannot be decreased.
A unique ID that identifies activities.

x-tiktok-request-body-parameters.Properties: You cannot update the products in `DEACTIVATED` or `EXPIRED` activities.

x-tiktok-request-body-parameters.Properties description: IDs of the BXGY exclude products to remove.

The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.
A unique ID that identifies different activities.
Activity name set by the merchant.
